text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: Why didn't I check more carefully…

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: Aaargh! I'm such a silly dum-dum!

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: If only I'd known there was a sale on… I could've stocked up on Toughness bars!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: After failing to keep up to date with the latest sales, Ines Fujin falls into a funk.
